notes.length: Inch, foot, yard and mile use the 1959 international definitions (1 in = 2.54 cm exactly). Ja = 10/33 m (≈30.3 cm).
notes.weight: 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg (exact). A geun depends on the item: 600 g for meat, 375 g for produce. 1 don = 3.75 g, 1 nyang = 10 don.
notes.area: 1 pyeong = 400/121 m² (≈3.3058 m²). The legal unit in Korea is m², and using pyeong in transactions and ads has been banned since July 2007. 1 danbo = 300 pyeong, 1 jeongbo = 3,000 pyeong.
notes.volume: US gallon (3.785 L) and UK gallon (4.546 L) differ. Doe/hop/mal follow the traditional system (1 doe ≈ 1.804 L); market measures may differ.
notes.temperature: Temperatures are converted with formulas, not factors. Absolute zero = 0 K = -273.15 °C = -459.67 °F.
notes.speed: 1 knot = 1 nautical mile per hour = 1.852 km/h. 1 mph = 1.609344 km/h.
notes.data: KB, MB, GB are powers of 1000 (SI); KiB, MiB, GiB are powers of 1024 (IEC). That is why a 1 TB disk shows as about 931 GB in Windows. 100 Mbps = 12.5 MB/s.
notes.time: 1 month = 30.436875 days and 1 year = 365.2425 days (Gregorian averages). Use the D-Day calculator for actual date differences.
notes.pressure: Tire pressure 35 psi ≈ 241 kPa ≈ 2.46 kgf/cm². 1 atm = 101,325 Pa (exact).
notes.energy: Food kcal uses the thermochemical calorie: 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ. 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ.
notes.fuel: For L/100km, lower is better (it is the reciprocal). Korea uses km/L, Europe L/100km, the US mpg.
notes.cooking: A Korean recipe cup is 200 mL, a US cup about 236.6 mL (240 mL on nutrition labels), a metric cup 250 mL. Tablespoon 15 mL, teaspoon 5 mL.
notes.traditional: Traditional Korean units are not legal units since the 1961 Measures Act, but remain common for real estate (pyeong), gold (don) and meat (geun). Tap a row to open its category.
notes.css: rem is relative to the root (html) font size, em to the parent element. In CSS 1in = 96px and 1pt = 4/3px.

unitConverter.title: Unit Converter
unitConverter.description: Convert single values and save unit pairs. For multiple values using the same pair, convert up to 1,000 lines and copy or export the full result while preserving blank and invalid rows.

howItWorks.title: How it works
items: Linear units convert to a base unit (m, kg, m², L...) and then to the target.
Exact definitions: 1 in = 0.0254 m, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 US gal = 3.785411784 L, 1 pyeong = 400/121 m².
Temperature goes through kelvin with formulas; L/100km is the reciprocal of km/L.
Very large or small values are shown in scientific notation (× 10ⁿ).

supported.title: Supported Units
items: Length: mm, cm, m, km, inch, ft, yard, mile

Temperature: Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin

whatIs.title: What is the Unit Converter?
whatIs.description: Convert a single value into units in the same category and save frequently used pairs. After choosing a specific pair, enter multiple values one per line and convert explicitly. Existing single input is separate from the new batch source and execution result.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: Choose a category and source/target units. Single values update immediately, and loading a favorite pair preserves the current number.
Check precision and the CSS rem base. Existing single-value URLs and recent conversions remain available.
Open batch conversion, enter one number per line and select Convert. Limits are 1,000 physical lines and 50,000 UTF-16 units; overlong input is not truncated.
Commas are numeric grouping marks. Blank lines stay blank; tabs, invalid values and non-finite results are marked as errors.
Check the first 200 preview rows and total/valid/error counts. Full TSV copy and CSV include the execution's units, precision, blank rows and errors.
After changing input or the unit pair, check the previous-result label and convert again. Batch source is not added to URLs, recent conversions or storage.

items.q: How many m² is one pyeong?
items.a: 1 pyeong = 6 ja × 6 ja with 1 ja = 10/33 m, so 400/121 m² ≈ 3.3058 m². m² to pyeong is × 0.3025.
SI: 1 GB = 1000 MB. IEC: 1 GiB = 1024 MiB. Drive makers use 1000; Windows shows 1024-based values labeled GB.

items.q: Why do meat and vegetable geun differ?
items.a: By custom, 1 geun of meat is 600 g and of produce 375 g (1/10 gwan). It has not been a legal unit since 1961.

items.q: How do I convert L/100km to km/L?
items.a: Divide 100 by it: 5 L/100km = 20 km/L. For US mpg, multiply by 0.4251 to get km/L.

items.q: Can I paste multiple CSV columns?
items.a: Each line is interpreted as one number. Commas are grouping marks, not CSV separators. A tab-containing row is marked as invalid rather than joining several values into one number.

items.q: Are blank and invalid rows dropped?
items.a: No. Original line numbers, blanks and errors are kept. An invalid row does not discard valid rows, and full copy/CSV includes every result row.

items.q: Are only the 200 preview rows exported?
items.a: No. The complete execution result, up to 1,000 rows, is available as TSV or CSV. Preview count and full-result count are distinguished.

items.q: Is batch source stored in a shared link or favorite?
items.a: Batch source is not added to URLs, localStorage, recent conversions or servers. Existing single-value links and favorite unit pairs are preserved.

favorites.title: Pinned conversions
favorites.description: Pin frequently used unit pairs. Loading one keeps your current input value and changes only the category, units, precision, and rem base.
favorites.name: Pinned name
favorites.nameHint: Up to {max} characters. Your numeric input is not saved.
favorites.loaded: Unit settings loaded. Your current input value is unchanged.
favorites.refreshed: Pinned list refreshed. Current input and unit settings are unchanged.
favorites.deletePrompt: Remove ‘{name}’ from the pinned list? Your current input and recent history will be kept.
favorites.traditionalUnavailable: The traditional-units overview cannot be pinned. Select a unit in the table to open an individual conversion, then pin it.
favorites.localOnly: Saved separately from recent history in this browser, with no automatic expiry. Clearing browser data removes the list. Pinned names and the list are not included in shared URLs.
favorites.recentInvalid: Some recent-history data could not be read, so automatic history saving has stopped. Existing data is preserved. Clear history to start recording again.
favorites.recentUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable, so recent history could not be updated. Check your storage settings or free space.
favorites.copyFailed: Could not copy. Check clipboard permission or select and copy the result manually.

errors.invalidData: The pinned list could not be read, so changes are blocked. Existing data has been preserved.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This pinned list uses a different version and cannot be changed here. Existing data has been preserved.
errors.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable, so the action could not be completed. Check your storage settings or free space, then refresh the pinned list.
errors.conflict: Another tab changed the pinned list. Refresh it before trying again.
errors.invalidPair: Select a supported category, unit pair, and precision. The rem base must be greater than 0 and less than 1,000px.
errors.invalidName: Enter a name of 1–40 characters without line breaks. A name cannot contain only spaces.
errors.duplicateName: A pinned conversion with this name already exists. Enter a different name.
errors.duplicatePair: This unit pair and precision are already pinned. Use the existing pinned conversion.
errors.limit: You can pin up to 12 conversions. Delete an unused entry before saving another.
errors.missingFavorite: This entry is no longer in the pinned list. Refresh the list.

batch.entryHint: Convert several numbers with the same pair of units.
batch.title: Batch conversion
batch.description: Enter one number per line. Commas are read as thousands separators. Lines containing tab-separated columns are marked as errors.
batch.choosePair: Choose two conversion units above first. The traditional-unit overview does not have a single conversion pair.
batch.limits: Up to {rows} lines and {characters} characters. Over-limit input is kept without truncation.
batch.linePolicy: Blank lines stay blank. One final newline ends the last line; any additional newlines remain blank rows.
batch.pending: Check the input and current units, then press Convert values.
batch.previous: The input or unit settings changed. The table, copy and CSV still use the previous conversion. Convert again to include the changes.
batch.preview: Showing the first {visible} rows. Copy and CSV include all {total} rows.
batch.downloadFailed: The CSV download could not start. Try again with the same results.
batch.privacy: This number list is not added to the URL, device storage, recent conversions or a server. Copy and download run only when you press their buttons.

errors.invalidPair: Choose a valid pair of conversion units first.
errors.tooManyCharacters: The input exceeds 50,000 characters. Shorten it and convert again.
errors.tooManyRows: The input exceeds 1,000 lines. Remove some lines and convert again.
errors.invalidNumber: This value cannot be read as a number.
errors.nonFiniteResult: The result is outside the calculable range for these units.
